svg.title: One picture, one red line, three autonomy levels
svg.desc: A hand-drawn left-to-right incident-remediation architecture: TRIAGE, GATHER, DIAGNOSE, PROPOSE, then a heavy red dashed APPROVAL BOUNDARY, then EXECUTE, VERIFY and REPORT, each badged A for auto, S for suggest or H for human-approved. A bounded cycle runs back from DIAGNOSE to GATHER carrying attempts 2 of 3. Under GATHER sit the hybrid runbook corpus and an allow-listed audited MCP server; under EXECUTE sit three blast-radius cards - restart pod and scale deployment both reversible, and rotate credential marked IRREVERSIBLE and struck out as not in scope - plus a green rollback box. A hachured Postgres store of checkpoints and audit log sits beneath everything with dashed lines to every node.
svg.text: One picture, one red line, three autonomy levels
A auto S suggest H human
every node reads and writes this
auto for 3 of 11 action types MTTR 41 -> 26 min
